note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. Run the recording session from an elevated shell (the container script needs it). The first container build (about 15 GB download) is done the day before with .\setup\New-LabBusinessCentral.ps1 -AcceptEula in elevated Windows PowerShell 5.1.
prepare: if (-not (Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw 'Docker Desktop (Windows containers) is not installed on the laptop yet: see blocked.' }
manual_prepare: Install Docker Desktop (owner confirms the licence terms), switch to Windows containers, then build the container the day before.
bckit seed once, note the BC numbers of Contoso Retail, Contoso Logistics Ltd, Contoso Hospitality Group.
Dataverse (Sales trial): account number on Contoso Retail; create Contoso Logistics Holdings and Contoso Legacy Store (LEGACY-1); person Alex Demo gives R005.
BC web client as admin: create and post a Sales Invoice for Contoso Retail; export MGL_BC_CONTOSO_NO.

screens.name: bc-container
screens.note: Second (idempotent) run: Docker check line, 'Container mglab-bc is already running.', API ok line. No password appears.

followup.account: admin (container user; the owner types the password off camera)
steps: Open the Business Central web client on CRONUS USA, Inc.
Show the company name in the header
mask: nothing secret exists; never show the password or a web service access key

screens.name: bckit-reconcile
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
screens.note: DATAVERSE_URL must point at the Sales trial environment. Scoped run expects R001, R002, R003, R005 and exit 1. Sign-in to Dataverse is interactive (leave the app-secret variables unset).

followup.account: admin (BC web client) and labadmin (Dataverse, make.powerapps.com / Sales Hub)
steps: BC web client: Customers, open the Contoso Retail card (number visible)
Sales Hub: Accounts, open Contoso Retail: same Account Number
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

manual_teardown: Optional when the episode is finished for good: delete C:\bcartifacts.cache and the BC images created for mglab-bc (docker rmi, those only).
Dataverse: clear Contoso Retail's account number; delete Contoso Logistics Holdings and Contoso Legacy Store.
Docker Desktop: back to Linux containers if other episodes need them.
needs: paid:none (container is free; about 15 GB disk)
licence:Docker Desktop terms (owner confirms before installing)
trial:Dynamics 365 Sales trial environment (ends about 21 Dec 2026)
blocked: Docker Desktop is not installed on the recording laptop (LAB.md toolchain), so the Business Central container and the bc-container, bckit-customers, bckit-invoices and bckit-reconcile screens cannot be recorded until the owner installs it (Windows containers, licence terms) and builds the container; the kit's terminal player runs PowerShell 7 while the container script wants an elevated Windows PowerShell 5.1 (hence powershell.exe in the commands).
